snippet.title: Mini Ninjas Adventures - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Game Page: http://eu.square-enix.com/en/games/mini-ninjas-adventures
Website: http://minininjas.com

[Square Enix]
Facebook: http://facebook.com/SquareEnix
Twitter: http://twitter.com/Square_Enix_Eu
Website: http://www.square-enix.com/eu/en/

Calling all ninjas! SQUARE ENIX is pleased to announce that Mini Ninjas™ Adventures will be available today across Europe and North America, exclusively on Xbox LIVE Arcade for Xbox 360.

Built specifically for Kinect for Xbox 360 video game and entertainment system from Microsoft , Mini Ninjas Adventures lets you use your mind, body and even your voice, to become the ninja you've always wanted to be. Get ready to ninja swipe, kick and battle through action packed levels, demonstrating your ninja prowess as you harness a range of weapons and secret Kuji magic to defeat all of those who stand in your way.
So pack your ninja stars, sword and more and get ready for adventure... a Mini Ninjas Adventure! 

Mini Ninjas Adventures is available today in Europe and North America exclusively for Kinect for Xbox 360 and is priced at 800 Microsoft Points
